title: Horton Winter 2019 Table 2: Bandit Fort, Triumph, Sculptor, Courtyard

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Winter 2019 Tournament Summary; Table 2, designed, played in the Swiss rounds

quality_note: Designer describes the Triumph line and its balance, but says Silver/Gold decks also won games.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule: players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. Cemetery's Heirloom: each player starts with Haunted Mirror in place of one Copper.
